meta.source: In-game Encyclopedia (Magic tab: base stats, traits, passives), captured 2026-11-28
meta.damage_rule: Combination base damage = Encyclopedia base damage of the Main Magic x the combination's 'Increase <Magic> Damage by NX' multiplier (community method; ultimates multiply on top). Trait 'X' multipliers (Lv.4 / Lv.7) are a separate multiplier tag and are listed separately.

magics.name: Magic Bolt
magics.description: Enhance the default projectile.

traits.name: Magic Arrow
traits.text: Magic Bolts penetrate all enemies.
buffs: Increase Magic Bolt Projectile Size by 180%
Increase Magic Bolt Projectile Speed by 180%

traits.name: Fireworks
traits.text: Magic Bolts split into threes and explode.
penalties: Increase Magic Bolt Cooldown by 2 sec.

traits.name: Fission
traits.text: Magic Bolts are fired towards 2 additional targets.

traits.name: Chain Casting
buffs: Increase the number of Magic Bolts by 1

traits.name: Fire at Will
traits.text: Magic Bolts are fired in random directions.
buffs: Increase the number of Magic Bolts by 5X
penalties: Increase Magic Bolt Cooldown by 3 sec.

traits.name: Doppelganger
traits.text: Instead of firing Magic Bolts, summon 3 Mirages that fire Magic Bolts.

magics.name: Fireball
magics.description: Launch an explosive projectile.

traits.name: Big Bang
traits.text: Increase the Damage and Size of the first Fireball by 1.5X.

traits.name: Toxic Gas
traits.text: The fireball's Explosion expands and damages enemies 3 times.

traits.name: Constellation
traits.text: Fireballs are fired at random locations and persist for a short duration, trailing the character. The Fireball's Movement Speed decreases gradually.

magics.name: Thunderstorm
magics.description: A thunderstorm falls upon nearby enemies.

traits.name: Thunderclap
traits.text: 1 to 3 Thunderstorms are created in a row.

traits.name: Lightning Explosion
traits.text: The Thunderstorm Explosion expands. Thunderstorms are created at random locations in order.

traits.name: Judgment
traits.text: All Thunderstorms are combined into one. Deal half as much Damage to enemies near the Thunderstorm Explosion. Each Thunderstorm increases the Size of the new Thunderstorm by 20%.

magics.name: Meteor
magics.description: A meteor falls on a random location.

traits.name: Volcanic Eruption
traits.text: Meteor explodes immediately and leaves a Crater that deals 25% damage every 0.5s

traits.name: Meteor Shower
buffs: Increase the number of Meteors by 3X

traits.name: Asteroid
traits.text: All Meteors are combined into one. Each Meteor increases the Size of the new Meteor by 50%.

magics.name: Cyclone
magics.description: Cause a gust of wind that grows in size and deals damage.

traits.name: Extreme Weather
buffs: Increase the number of Cyclones by 2

traits.name: Electric Orb
traits.text: The Cyclone gradually shrinks and launches projectiles in random directions.

traits.name: Void
traits.text: The Cyclones are created at random locations in order and do not move.
buffs: Increase Cyclone Size Increase Speed by 9X

magics.name: Electric Shock
magics.description: Release electricity in a random direction.

traits.name: Chain Lightning
traits.text: 1 to 3 Electric Shocks are created in a row.

traits.name: High Output
traits.text: Electric Shock Explodes when it disappears. Electric Shock Size Increase Rate is Converted into Damage.

traits.name: Superconductivity
traits.text: Electric Shocks are created towards nearby enemies in order.

magics.name: Energy Bolt
magics.description: Fire a penetrating projectile nearby.

traits.name: Charged Particle
traits.text: The Energy Bolt returns to the character when its duration is over.
buffs: Increase the number of Energy Bolts by 35%
Increase Energy Bolt Projectile Speed by 35%

traits.name: Spark
traits.text: Energy Bolts deal damage every 0.3 seconds.

traits.name: Flare
traits.text: Energy Bolts disperse in all directions at once and explode for twice the damage when its duration is over.

magics.name: Incineration
magics.description: Launch flames in front of the character.

traits.name: Flamestrike
traits.text: Each Incineration becomes more powerful than the last. (Max Multiplier: Damage X4, Size X1.5)
buffs: Increase the number of Incinerations by 25%

traits.name: Pyromaniac
traits.text: Create 2 Flames with the same Damage whenever casting Incineration.

traits.name: Cerberus Flame
traits.text: Incineration also fires sideways.
penalties: Decrease the number of Incinerations by 33%

magics.name: Blizzard
magics.description: Raise a Blizzard that freezes enemies.

traits.name: Sub-Zero
traits.text: Decrease the Movement Speed of all enemies by 3% per second whenever Blizzard is active. Movement Speed Decrease is reset after Blizzard is finished.
buffs: Increase the number of Blizzards by 30%

traits.name: Shooting Star
traits.text: Blizzard falls at a slower speed.
penalties: Decrease the number of Blizzards by 50%

traits.name: Conflagration
traits.text: Blizzards immediately explode 2 times in a row, and each Explosion reduces its Damage by 10%. Blizzard no longer freezes enemies.

magics.name: Tsunami
magics.description: Create a giant wave that crosses through the field.

traits.name: Pole
traits.text: Multiple Tsunamis are created from all directions at the same time and freeze enemies.

traits.name: Siren's Song
traits.text: Tsunamis are created near the direction the character is moving in.
penalties: Decrease the number of Tsunamis by 50%

traits.name: Great Eruption
traits.text: Tsunamis are created over a larger radius.

magics.name: Spirit
magics.description: Summon a Spirit that augments attacks.

traits.name: Magic Missile
traits.text: Decrease Spirit Cooldown scaling to the number of Spirits. Spirits launch their projectiles over the same interval as its Cooldown.

traits.name: Magic Blade
traits.text: The Spirit's blade-shaped projectile is created immediately on its target.

traits.name: Familiar
traits.text: All Spirits are combined into one. The Spirit launches projectiles in all directions.
buffs: Increase Projectiles Fired by 15 for each Spirit

magics.name: Satellite
magics.description: Create a Satellite that rotates around the character.

traits.name: Anti-Gravity
traits.text: The Satellites' Rotation Speed increases up to 3X and cycles back to its normal state.

traits.name: Will o' the Wisp
traits.text: Satellites rotate around the character in two radii.
buffs: Increase the number of Satellites by 2X

traits.name: Nuclear Fusion
traits.text: All Satellites are combined into one. The Satellite deals damage every 0.3 seconds.
buffs: Increase Damage Multiplier by 1 for each Satellite
Increase Size Multiplier by 1 for each Satellite

magics.name: Arcane Ray
magics.description: Shoot a ray that penetrates all objects.

traits.name: Reflect
traits.text: Arcane Rays are also created on the opposite side.

traits.name: Disintegration Ray
traits.text: Arcane Rays rotate around the character at a fast speed.

traits.name: Electromagnetic Burst
traits.text: Fire 1-Max Number Arcane Rays in random directions. Arcane Rays deal damage every 0.5 seconds.

magics.name: Electric Zone
magics.description: Damage nearby enemies over a certain interval.

traits.name: EMP
traits.text: Enemies are stunned after every 4 times they receive damage from Electric Zone.
buffs: Decrease Electric Zone Damage Interval by 10%

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: The Electric Zone no longer damages enemies multiple times, but expands and disappears over a certain cycle. The Cycle's length is inversely related to the Damage Interval.
penalties: Increase Electric Zone Damage Interval by 3X

magics.name: Frost Nova
magics.description: Freeze nearby enemies for a moment.

traits.name: Absolute Zero
traits.text: Freeze enemies near the Frost Nova's Explosion.

traits.name: Ice Age
traits.text: Frost Nova explodes 3 times in a row, and each Explosion increases its Damage and Size by 1.5X.

traits.name: Earthquake
traits.text: Frost Nova no longer freezes enemies but stuns them.

magics.name: Lava Zone
magics.description: Create a Lava Zone that continuously damages enemies for a certain duration.

traits.name: Melt
traits.text: Enemies take 5% additional Damage whenever taking Damage from Lava Zone. (Max Multiplier: 30%)

traits.name: Crater
buffs: Increase the number of Lava Zones by 2X

traits.name: Magma Eruption
traits.text: All Lava Zones are combined into one. Each Lava Zone increases the Size of the new Lava Zone by 30%.

magics.name: Shield
magics.description: Create a Shield that blocks damage once.

traits.name: Barrier
buffs: Increase the maximum number of Shields by 2

traits.name: Reconstruct
traits.text: Charge 2 shields at once.
buffs: Increase the maximum number of Shields by 1

traits.name: Destruction Field
traits.text: Cause an Explosion when the Shield is broken. The Explosion trails the character for a short duration and damages enemies 4 times.

magics.name: Cloaking
magics.description: Pass through all objects for a moment, and increase Movement Speed.

traits.name: Space Warp
traits.text: Cause a powerful Explosion near the character when Cloaking duration is over.

traits.name: Soul Harvest
traits.text: Recover 0.1% HP for each enemy killed while in Cloaking, and increase Mana Acquisition by 33%.

magics.name: Magic Circle
magics.description: Amplify ATK for a certain duration.

traits.name: Unleash Mana
traits.text: Decrease All Magic Cooldown by 15% when Magic Circle is active.

traits.name: Material Synthesis
traits.text: Create 5 items around the character when Magic Circle is cast.

traits.name: Great Magic Circle
traits.text: Increase Magic Circle effect by 2X.

magics.name: Armageddon
magics.description: Remove all enemies.

traits.name: Apocalypse
traits.text: After the Armageddon Explosion, decrease the HP of all enemies by 40%. Over 20 seconds, the HP Decrease returns to 0%.

traits.name: Rapture
traits.text: Recover all HP after every 4th Armageddon.
buffs: Increase HP Regen per sec. by 0.1%

traits.name: Doom Prophet
traits.text: Each Mana Orb decreases the remaining Cooldown of Armageddon by 1%.

magics.name: Flash Shock
magics.description: Create a flash that moves in the direction that the character is currently moving towards and damages enemies.

traits.name: Wipeout
traits.text: The center of the Flash Shock deals 10X additional Damage.

traits.name: Ragnarok
traits.text: Flash Shock is created over a wider range.
buffs: Increase the number of Flash Shocks by 5

traits.name: Satan's Nails
traits.text: Flash Shocks are created in random positions and directions. Two Flash Shocks are created next to the Flash Shock, and every cast increases the number of times this Magic is cast by 1. Magic Cast Stack is reset after every 4th cast of Flash Shock.

magics.name: Vitality
effects: Increase Life Orb HP Recovery by 10%

magics.name: Lord of Fire
effects: Increase the Damage of the following Magic by 25%: Fireball, Meteor, Incineration, Lava Zone

magics.name: Stormy Clouds
effects: Increase the Damage of the following Magic by 25%: Thunderstorm, Electric Shock, Electric Zone, Flash Shock

magics.name: Nature's Wrath
effects: Increase the Damage of the following Magic by 25%: Cyclone, Blizzard, Tsunami, Frost Nova

magics.name: Energy Engineering
effects: Increase the Damage of the following Magic by 25%: Energy Bolt, Arcane Ray, Spirit, Satellite

magics.name: Timekeeper
effects: Increase the duration of Rune effects by 12%

magics.name: Seal
effects: Decrease the Movement Speed of all enemies by 8%.

magics.name: Curse
effects: Decrease the Max HP of all enemies by 6%.

magics.name: Mana Factory
effects: Mana Orbs are created 20% more frequently.

magics.name: Blood Magic
penalties: Decrease HP Regen per sec. by 0.25%

magics.name: Adrenaline
effects: Increase ATK, Critical Strike Rate, Movement Speed by 5%

magics.name: Priest
effects: Decrease the Max HP of all enemies by 3%
Increase HP Regen per sec. by 0.3%

magics.name: Eldritch
effects: Decrease the Max HP of Elite Monsters by 10%.

magics.name: Taoist
effects: Increase all Additional Passive spell levels by 1

magics.name: Florist
effects: All products sold by Merchants are 7% Discounted
